summary: Test suite provides solid coverage of core aggregation logic (XML/JSON parsing, flaky detection, markdown output) and basic error handling. However, it has critical gaps: (1) Does NOT test actual workflow execution through act, violating the explicit requirement 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT'; (2) Limited edge-case coverage (no special characters in test names, no malformed XML, no file I/O errors, no numeric precision validation); (3) YAML structure validation via grep is brittle (whitespace-sensitive); (4) Fixture content not shown/verified in test code. The bats tests run the script directly rather than through the CI pipeline as required. Would catch regressions in core parsing/aggregation but not workflow integration, environmental issues, or boundary conditions.
